info.name: Kahwety API
info.description: Production Postman Collection for Kahwety Cafe Platform API (FastAPI backend). Includes Authentication, Admins, Permissions, Users, Cafes, Branches, Google Maps, Products, Offers, Events, Complaints, Subscriptions, Coupons, Notifications, Dashboard, Suggested Cafes, Mobile API, File Uploads, and Webhooks.
